title: Youth Study Studio
description: Youth Study Studio Youth Artists on the Rise (YAR) Ages 13 – 17 | FREE January 22-28 (excluding weekends) | 12:00-3:00PM Art Activity Room and Underground Gallery (Level B1) | 50 Victoria Street, Aurora Need a space to study or create during exam week? We got you covered! The Aurora Cultural Centre is designating Level B1 as a student-only zone during Winter Exam Week, providing a quiet and creative environment for studying and project work. Students will have access to the Art Activity Room, a fully equipped art studio, and the Underground Gallery. Group studying is welcome; we kindly ask all attendees to keep the volume to a minimum. What is Youth Artists on the Rise (YAR)? A community for arts-impassioned youth ages 13-17 to develop their skills in the arts, make connections, and build a community for collaboration and growth. Participants have access to art studio space, exhibiting opportunities, and workshops. Register for Youth Artists on the Rise!
